title: Alert latch and correlator unlatch
description: Platform demo matrix: Alert latch and correlator unlatch
prompt: On demo-device-1 (create virtual-unified if needed) configure an alert that latches on event1 and a correlator that unlatches or follows up when event2 fires with intValue greater than 20. Put rules under alert-rules and correlators with demo- prefix names demo-event1-latch and demo-event2-unlatch.
